'''Executive Captain''' was a position within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. [[Marok]], serving under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]] aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Impending Doom]]'', held the rank of Executive Captain.
